Name: Custom NPC Haru
Author: tpgml
Description:
Marriage possibility, festival participation, spouse room, movie theater, etc.
 Has been added. The original author is IUMVXR and the original NPC is posted on the IUMVXR Naver blog.
On the IUVXR Naver blog, he can't get married.
So I added the marriage function.
The address of the IUMVXR Naver blog is https://blog.naver.com/mary1223th/221896784516.
All Naver modes require login.
I do not speak English as my native language, so I wrote it using Korean.
Heart Event Guide, Gift Tastes are in a txt file in a folder and written in Korean.
Please post if you can submit a better translation.
install
Install the latest version SMAPI, Content Patcher Mod, TMXL Map Tookit Mod, PyTK (Platonymous Toolikit) Mod.
[CP] Haru, [TMX] Haru Festival, [TMX] Haru Spouses keeps folder folders in Stardew Valley / Mods.
Start the game using SMAPI.
compatibility
-Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.4.5.
-MissCoriel's unique courtship response is compatible and recommended, but not required!
It has not been tested with other custom NPCs. Let us know if your schedule conflicts with others!
